scope_boundary: Repository and supplied immutable evidence only. No credentials, live provider calls, remote mutations, resource changes, or spend were authorized or performed.
repaired_findings: Cloud Run no longer receives reusable pre-signed output PUT URLs before output bytes exist.

Migration 0030 requires an active, unexpired attempt and the exact callback token, tenant/project/revision/attempt object lineage, source, object key, content type, content length, and SHA-256 before signing.
R2 SigV4 binds content-length, content-type, and x-amz-checksum-sha256 for PUT; the worker independently rejects any returned authority mismatch.
Upload authorization is exact-idempotent and rejects changed facts or terminal/cancelled attempts.

P1.detail: No supplied immutable evidence proves deployed Better Auth, non-superuser Neon RLS, private R2, Cloudflare Worker/Workflow, scale-to-zero Cloud Run ASR/render parity, two-real-account isolation, restart/replay/cancel/retention, backup/restore, cost settlement, rollback, no-Mac operation, or real Chrome staging acceptance. Local fixtures do not prove deployment.

The hosted surface still exposes auth, tenant, status, attempt read/cancel, callback, and upload authority only. Most existing product APIs return HOSTED_ROUTE_NOT_COMPOSED, and no hosted request route creates the CPU attempt, job spec, output-authority rows, and Workflow launch required for an end-to-end hosted ASR/render job.

Live inventory was explicitly forbidden. The only supplied RunPod snapshot is stale: zero workers, two retained 50 GB volumes, and USD 7.00/month recurring total. It cannot prove current zero-worker or current billing truth.

P2.detail: Rollback, backup, and restore are locally specified and validated but have no supplied hosted execution evidence.
